Sweet curd
desserts
note: Paskha is a festive Easter dish of Eastern Orthodox countries: eaten at the end of Lent, so rich in the dairy foods given up. Cooked version is an egg custard with the curd; the uncooked keeps poorly, so batches are smaller.

about.text: Curd (tvorog or quark) pressed, sieved and mixed with sugar, butter, sour cream or egg, sometimes cooked, and set in a mould; the East Slavic Easter dish paskha is the classic.
